comments.author: @KR4Qep
comments.text:
Im in love with these shows coming out that have so much heart, great writing and acting and just relatable stories. 
This show blew me away and wasn't remotely close to what I was expecting. 

My top recent shows right now are Master of None, Reservation Dogs and now High Maintenance. I remember watching My So Called in the 90s and thinking "this is what genuine TV feels like" and then there being a void until Freaks and Geeks came out. Then another dry spell and streaming services started giving creators the freedom to make some truly wonderful stuff. 

From what I'm seeing it seems like there is a stigma that its just a stoner show and its sad that people are depriving themselves of this, truly, work of art. Its so touching and interesting. 

I really wish they'd do a season 5 but the creators are moving on to new projects and I'm definitely excited to see what they come out with next.

comments.author: @Spdking7
comments.text: Man so many people quick to jump the gun and say it's trash.  Just because it's literally nothing like other hbo shows doesn't mean it's good. It's literally a show about a guy who deals weed and you see his daily life, and the life of the people who buy weed. Fantastic fucking show. You just have to be open minded to anything. It shows the life of new York. The melting pot. All sorts of religion, ethnicities. You catch the glimpse of the daily life of someone else. If you're not open minded you really wouldn't like this show. But if you are accepting and laid back, sit back and enjoy 4 seasons.
